prompts: A game using this MonoGame version stutters while clearing roughly 4,000 cached graphics resources out of about 30,000 live resources. Investigate the CPU-side registration/removal path and propose a focused performance repair. Trace resource assignment, reassignment to another GraphicsDevice, explicit disposal, finalization, device disposal and resetting across the relevant classes and platform partials. Determine whether collection order or weak-reference identity is part of the behavior that a replacement must preserve. Do not inspect upstream fixes or launch graphics windows; this task is a source-based performance and lifetime investigation, not a rendering benchmark.

Review the proposed repair for mutation during traversal, locking, stale weak references, duplicate registration and device ownership. Specify meaningful regression and performance checks and distinguish CPU-side evidence from GPU/runtime behavior that has not been tested. Save REPORT.json with findings [{id,statement,evidence:[{path,line}],certainty}] and testPlan. Use ids complexity, registration, reassignment, disposal, finalization, traversal, resetting and platform-scope. The final recommendation must cover correctness and practical verification, not only replace a collection type. Do not change production source.
